matchups.tips: Same thing, she needs the jg. Aggressive.

Same thing here, but if he wants to farm all the time under tower he will be able and you won't be able to kill him, but if so, you have total control of lane, you can invade, rotate, you can do whatever you want.

If he gets behind in level (XP) he totally lose, look for following the roams with your R, and if in CD, look for pushing as much as you can to force him to decided between stay or leave but if he does, he lose, control your back timings, the best tp here.

Just play with his CDs, bait his "E" and you totally destroy him, better if you make him to be far away from his tower, so you will have more room to all-in him, if you let yourself get poke, you can still out play if maxing "W".

Is easy, the thing is if she wants you never touch her, cause' of her range, just don't let yourself to get poke a lot, and in the best opportunity or spot she miss-step you all-in and she will die, probably she will take barrier, so you will have to deal with it, but is easy, the thing is that, reach her.
Easy, play aggresive, but if you play to scale, you totally lose.
You win, + you get so buff with his "R" Yes it gives you the stacks and size too.
You totally destroy him early, and late, when you get his "R" is so funny and comfy to play.

This is tricky in the first 3 levels, and depeding how you play it out it can become easy match up, or hard. Avoid getting a lot of poke, and look for all-ins, once she decided to use his Q, or W to farm. if everything goes wrong, play for level 6, and at level 6 you surely win.
Play to dogde the root "E" and you win, heavy poke so second wind and doran shild is good, play it slow.
Play aggresive, if you play to scale you'll lose, take ignite, and level 6, his ultimate increases the dmg you deal to him.

Tricky, but free "W" on her anytime she'll use her "W" difficult to get into her, so just play slow, and wait for the right moment, level 6 try to look out for her chains "E" so you increase the chances of killing her.

You can play aggresive, but if you fail your "E" and you don't have tp, you are gonna lose due to the heavy poke, but if you have a ganking jungler play with him, and he is pretty dead anyways, later on you win.
You win, but if he gets a little ahead, and he knows how to position, you shouldn't be able to kill him, + level 6 is a power spike for both, due to the gank set up, you both get.
Play aggresive early, and get ahead, if you don't you'll ended up losing.
His "R" isn't that good, and he can poke you down, + his "W" allows him to scape in case you get in range, play slow, and look for opportunities with your JG.

Constant poke, and if you use your "E" towards him without baiting out first his "E" or "W" you'll get stun and out-damaged, your "E" is very important in this match up, use it to dogde his "W" stay away from the minions so you don't get the extended "E" and then you can engage pretty easy.

Her early is bad, but still her combo of "Q+E" hurts a lot, what you can do is use your "E" to dogde and engage with your "E2" and in that way you will win, also another tip is if she use "Q" and you use "E2" she won't be able to CC you cause' she will be CC and you will win again. Post level 6 just use your "E2" whenever she has "R" to cancel her "R", if you fail your "E" and she didn't use anything, then she can easilly kill you post 6.
Heavy poke, and difficult to reach, but if you find the right moment you kill him pretty easy. try to stay a little away from the minions so the AOE of his "Q+Q" doesn't poke you down.
Bait her "E" and then all in her with your "E", if you engage first you are gonna get stun by her "E" and then lose the trade.

I find it pretty easy, try to punish whatever she goes for cs with your "W", and then use your "E" to cancel her "R" and always walk to the otherside where the dagger land it will allow you to reduce basically all of her dmg.

Uff, tricky but easy if you know how, he shouldn't be able to kill you if you play properly, try to avoid taking dmg without trading back, cause' if you get to low in early then he will ignite you + all-in and you won't be able to heal back ending up killing you, after level 6 try to use your "E" when he is low to avoid using his "R"

ZED is a perfect example of "tricky" match-up where it can go either good or bad, he is problaly gonna play with "Q" and poke with "W", if you get low enough, or below 40% of health you are gonna lose due that he can ignite you before you will use your "W" and you won't heal back and he will win, I'd recommend to step behind the minions if you can't dogde the "Q" so it deals less dmg, and use your "E" to dogde his "W+E+Q" combo, use it either aggresive, so you dogde but also deal dmg, or use it defesive just to avoid the burst. Use his "R" to dogde his "R" and also be able to follow him, if he gets ahead, you aren't gonna recover.

It is easier than zed's match-up but still if he has ignite and you both have 50% of health, he has higher chances or killing you, try to use your "E" to avoid either the first cast of his "W" or the return of the same one, as always as you are looking for avoid the passive of talon you are good if you fell behind you can still recover.

This is a highly "CD" match-up, try to deal with her by baiting out her "W" and then trading meanwhile it is in CD, so I don't think she can win, but again remember like any other assasin if you both are low, and she has ignite, she has higher chances of winning the duel.

If she has ignite like other assasins, and you are low health specially this one will kill you due that his "Q" deals more dmg between lower your health is, engage with your "W" and keep trades short but longer than usual, try to use your "E" to get out of her range, and if she follows, and fail his "Q" engage back with your second "E" cast. EXTRA TIP AS I'M LEARNING NEW THINGS TOO; -STAND BEHIND THE MINIONS SO HER "Q" WILL DEAL ONLY 75% OF THE DMG.

Same thing that quiyana, if you both are low and yes without ignite you'd likely to outplay him but with ignite, he will just ignite you before you use your "W" and you will ended up dying. try to use your "E" to dogde his second dmg from his "E" once this is done engage back with your second cast "E", and you should win, if you use your "E" first you will likely lose the trade early on, as time progress your chances or winning this match up increase.

You win early similar to veigar, but not like veigar directly, he still has some treat on you, play aggresive, don't let him get farm so easy, and keep trading, if he gets late, nothing to do, nothing, unless you play the early properly otherwise, mid starts becoming akward and late is FF.

Constant poke, try to hit your "E" if you don't there is nothing to do, she will punish you by poking you down, step behind the minions so her "Q" will deal less dmg, if she max out "W" then you will need to trade back, and look for all-ins whatever she will do that, if you keep faling your "E" then just farm, cause' she will kill you.

Similar to orianna, you rely on your "E" if you fail you get punish, if she takes "aery" then she will ended up dying, if you find it hard early, try to play for level 6 and watch out for her jungler of course, but also it becomes a threat for her too.

Mix between Ori and Lux, she can constantly poke, and you to respond with all-in, you need her to use her "E" otherwise if she decides so, you'll never reach her. And in late-mid game if you fail your "E" and you don't have zhonyas she will be able to kill you. This match up depends a lot in how good the syndra is with holding her "E" as always as she has the "E" you shouldn't be able to kill her, of course it has HIGH "CD" 17SECS.

Same thing that syndra, but easier I'd say, watch out at level 6, cause' he can kill you if you mess up with your "E" find spots to get into him, and try to dogde, bait out his "E" if you don't you will take a ugly trade, in the worse of the cases don't try to run away, but stay close so he can't use his "R" walk or dash through him.

Play with her passive, if she doesn't waste her passive you won't be able to trade with her, if so wait for level 6, and look for all-ins cause' then you'll win you need her to be away from her tower, otherwise, she will win.

You can't really use your "E" never as always as she has "E" you'll get stunned and outdamaged, also her "R" isn't the best "R" for you, it just helps you to maybe reposition yourself for a better "Q" or something but try to play next and behind the minions so she use her "E" if she fails such ability feel free to all-in, and winning it, but it depends a lof of her "E".

keep short trades, and let him outplay himself, he will win long trades, also, use your "Q" to take out his passive, and "W" to engage + AA (PASSIVE) and "E" in case he engage on you so you can go out of his range, and repeat, if both are low, your opportunities to win are higher even if he has ignite. Keep the wave near of your tower, and play around it. If you engage with your "E" and fail the second cast, probably he will run you down, and ended up winning the match up.

Similar to Yasuo, only look for shorts trades.If both are low you have higher chances of winning even if he has ignite.Just be careful with his "W" and use your "E" to dogde his "R" or his 3rd "Q" and you should be fine.

Naturally he is gonna counter you, specially if he takes aftershock, bone plating, and then he rush grievous wounds into ignite, you won't be able to fight really, look always for burning out his Bone plating in case you want to fight, and use your "E" to disengage, and engage back with the second cast, so you have higher chances of dodging his "W", if he lets himself to be "poke" and you are healthy enough you can look for all-ins, but generally play better for wave, and look for roam with his "R". In skirmish is highly possible you are gonna win against.

D.SHILD, SECOND WIND, and unless you don't miss your "E" and your burn his bone plating previously, you can win a trade, however he will be all the time poking you down, and also out pushing you totally if you max "W" you will never ever have prio by your own unless your jungler creates a pyshological pressure on him, if you max "Q" you will be able to farm more comfortable. If you try to all-in him and you fail your "E" he will GIGA PUNISH YOU, in long trades he will also destroy you, so is pretty difficult matchup.

This match up has two ways to be play and it depends a lot of his rune "CONQUEROR, OR PTA". If he goes CONQUEROR, you need to have at least some source of sustain let's say D.SHILD or second wind, cause' he is gonna play to poke you down with the "Q", try to use your "E" to dogde such ability, and try to engage back for a FAST trade with "E2, AA, W" better if his "E" is in CD, otherwise he can deny the dmg, if he has conqueror never take long trades and keep yourself with short ones even if you have conqueror he will win, and if he has ignite or grievous wounds, you will never win long trades. If he goes PTA, here is similar to conqueror, but he will be stronger to all-ins, and mostly he will play with passive + "W" so the PTA activates right after you get CC. in this case be aware of his "W" so you can use your "E" to get out of his range, and engage back for a fast trade. another thing is keep the wave near your tower, so is harder for him to run you down, and easier for you to trade and get away.

Annoying match up, specially cause' if he times well he can cancel your "W" so you won't deal dmg and also you won't heal which is really annoying, it's a lane of constant poke, you can start even with "Q" to farm better and also to attack him in a safer way I'd say, if you start with "E", I'd reccomend to start with D.SHILD, due that if you fail your "E2" he will harass you uglily, and also isn't the best start unless maybe if you have an active jungler example, (XIN ZHAO, SHACO) otherwise, he will create big waves and if you hit your "E2" you will just get destroy by his dmg, and also the minion wave dmg, look for trades whenever he is in "range form" so he lose defenses and is more possible that you will win the trade either if is long or short, his "R" is bad as hell for you so in case you are low his R, will give you extra range like him, but nothing else. try also to engage with your "E1" and save your "E2" after he use his "E TO PUSH YOU AWAY" so you are able to reengage.
Try to dodge Q2 and just farm, you're better in team fights.
Annoying early but I would do Q max to farm then you outscale easy.
Respect E and Shroud. Whoever ults first wins usually.
No info

Difficult match up, you'll lose long trades it means if you don't one shot him which is impossible with his "W" up, if he survives your rotation of abilities, then he will win the duel specially if you let yourself get hit by his "W" in lane, you'll need to watch out his "E" use your "E" to either dogde the stun, or dogde his "W", and then heavy trade him and disengage afterwards. Keep the trades shorts and once he is low, look for kill again, be careful with his "W", "E".

Heavy poke, uff, this match up is skill but more on Cassiopeia's favor, you can take ignite, or tp, but generally you never know if she'll be good with her "Q" and save her "W" so take TP + D. SHILD + SECOND WIND. Fake when you'll going to cs so she will waste her "Q" and you will have a window of 6secs, to all-in her and go away, play near your tower, and buy boots as soon as possible so it is harder for her to hit the "Q", if she doesn't use the "W" properly she is pretty dead, but if she save it, and play it slowly with that, be careful, and just play for waves, and small trades, if you are far from your tower a bad trade means a kill for her.

Constant poke, better long trades. TP + D. SHILD + SECOND WIND. Max your "Q" play to farm, and look for spots to do smalls trades, better if you play for setting up ganks for your jungler, or your support. Play to don't let him roam, and try to don't engage with your "E" cause' if he has his "E" he will be able to go out of your range, and punish you hard probably push you out of lane. If he takes "BONE PLATING" then you must take it first with a "Q" before going for any trade, otherwise, you'll lose. UPDATE; TRY TO TAKE FIRST STRIKE, AND PLAY WITH YOUR "Q" ALSO GO FOR ROA.

Constant poke, here you need definitely TP + SECOND WIN + D. SHILD, otherwise you won't survive the lane, and be careful with your all-ins cause' you can die there, the best is play with your jungler and just all-in him whatever your jungler comes, be careful of feeding him cause' if it happens even if your jungler comes you will both die, or one, MAX "Q" in the worse of the situations and play for wave, tempo and roamings, you don't have to KILL him.

Keep as much as you can the wave near your tower, and look for trades whenever she goes for a minion with your "W", + "AA" and use your "E" to dogde her "E" if you get hit by her "E" you'll probably lose the match up, keeping the wave near your tower allows you to use your "E" in aggresive way due that even if you get hit by her "E" she won't dive you, let her basically outplay herself. Be patient in this match-up and play slow.
